page.notes: The two medallions are coin illustrations. Left: bearded laureate head facing right, legend around the rim reading approximately "PERTINAX" and "AVG" with "P AELIVS" beside it. Right: draped female bust facing left with an elaborate hairstyle, legend reading approximately "FLAVIA TITIANA" and "P AEL PER VX" on the rim. The coin legends are only partly legible on the scan and are not transcribed. The Latin text is clear throughout; the italic passages are as printed.
